 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 04-09-2025 Heard the parties.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the following relief(s):
"(i) for direction to the respondent authorities to calculate the compensation amount of the land of the petitioners under the commercial head instead of agricultural head/rate as Patna High Court CWJC No.14016 of 2025(2) dt.04-09-2025 calculated Sangita Devi @ Sangita vs The State Of Bihar on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19932223/
1 vide notices dated 13/03/2024 and 25.02.2025 (Annexure-5 series) issued to the petitioners under section 3E of National High Way Act, 1956 under Siwan District in Land Acquisition Case No. 28/2023-24 and 24/2024-25 for (Ramjanaki Path Pariyojana NH-227A) as per the physical existence of the lands keeping in view of the sale deeds of the surrounding land/plots of petitioners upon which stamp duty has been paid as per commercial rate fixed by the government for the lands situated at Siwan-Mairwa (S.H.) main road under Mauza Titra.

entities.text: Sangita Devi @ Sangita vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) For direction to the respondent authorities to make compensation to the commercial plots of the petitioners situated at Siwan-Mairwa(S.H.) main road which is under acquisition process for construction of Ramjanaki Path NH227A in L.A. Case No.28/2023-24 and 24/2024-25.

(iii) For direction to the respondent authorities not to start construction of Ramjanaki Path NH227A till awarding compensation under Patna High Court CWJC No.14016 of 2025(2) dt.04-09-2025 Commercial head for commercial plots under agricultural heads for the agricultural plots.
(iv) For direction to the respondents to calculate the compensation amounts under land acquisition process under commercial heads giving details of area which has been included under acquisition notice (Annexure-4 series) for obtaining compensation amount in Land Acquisition Case No. 28/2023-24 and 24/20204- (v) For any other relief/reliefs as your lordship may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."

3 . At the outset, learned counsel for the NHAI submits that already the award has been prepared by the Competent Officer-cum-District Land Acquisition Officer, Siwan and as such, if the petitioner wants enhanced compensation, he has to move before the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner,
Saran at Chapra (respondent no. 3).
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he shall be doing the needful in next four weeks.

5. With the consent of the parties the writ petition Patna High Court CWJC No.14016 of 2025(2)
dt.04-09-2025 stands disposed of allowing the petitioner to approach the concerned authority, the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner, Saran at Chapra (respondent no. 3) in next four weeks and if such petition is filed, to take the matter to its logical conclusion within the time frame stipulated under the Act.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
